summary: Completed testing of Zone Management features (iteration 7). All 15 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. Features tested: zone CRUD with multi-user assignment, assigned_buildings sync on users, zone enforcement for reservations, user-buildings endpoint, summary stats, unassigned users warning, Select All/Deselect All, edit zone pre-population, admin Reservations link.
critical_code_review_comments: Zone CRUD operations fully working with proper user assignment sync
POST /api/zones correctly creates zone with assigned_users and syncs assigned_buildings on user records
PUT /api/zones/{id} correctly updates zone, adds/removes users, and syncs assigned_buildings
DELETE /api/zones/{id} removes building from users' assigned_buildings when no other zones remain
GET /api/zones/user-buildings returns buildings assigned to current user via zones
Zone enforcement: booking in building WITH zones fails for non-assigned users (403)
Zone enforcement: booking in building WITHOUT zones succeeds for any user
Zone enforcement: admins can always book regardless of zone assignments
Zone access control: regular users get 403 on GET/POST /api/zones but CAN access /api/zones/user-buildings
Frontend: Zone Management page shows summary stats (Total Zones, Buildings with Zones, Assigned Users, Unassigned Users)
Frontend: Unassigned users warning banner shows users not in any zone with badges
Frontend: Create/Edit zone dialog has multi-user selector with checkboxes, search, and Select All/Deselect All
Frontend: Selected users appear as removable badges above the user list
Frontend: Edit zone dialog pre-populates with existing zone data including selected users
Frontend: Zone cards display all assigned user names as badges
Frontend: Admin sidebar Reservations link navigates to /admin/reservations correctly
All data-testid attributes present and functional
seed_data_creation: Test zones created during testing were cleaned up automatically via pytest fixtures and UI delete
context_for_next_testing_agent: Zone Management features fully working. Key endpoints: POST/PUT/DELETE /api/zones, GET /api/zones/user-buildings. Zone enforcement blocks non-assigned users from booking in buildings that have zones (403). Frontend ZoneManagement.js has complete multi-user selector with checkboxes, search, Select All. Test data-testids: 'add-zone-btn', 'zone-name-input', 'zone-building-select', 'zone-device-input', 'zone-user-search', 'select-all-users-btn', 'user-checkbox-{userId}', 'selected-user-{userId}', 'save-zone-btn', 'edit-zone-{zoneId}', 'delete-zone-{zoneId}', 'stat-zones', 'stat-unassigned', 'user-checklist'.
